scope: current authenticated account and current captured frontend snapshots; not platform-wide or cross-role

definitions.operationVsPath: Observed operations may share a path but differ by method or gateway operation type; static candidates are path-based.
definitions.parameterCompleteness: Partition and pairwise coverage is used for finite parameter classes. It does not claim the impossible Cartesian product of arbitrary values.
definitions.writePolicy: Write-like methods and paths are classified only; they are never executed.
